note: Cluster C (life situations), 2026-08-18. Fixtures-first: pending until
the proposed lexicon patch to remembered-work-as-for-the-lord lands
(see the cluster's patches.md) and this passes. Idea confirmed by the
prayer books' 'New Job' and 'Being a Godly Employee' topics and
Phillips 'Occupation' — topic ideas only, no verse list copied.
The patch adds the life-situation aliases 'new job' and 'my job' to the
existing single-anchor pack, so a job-seeker's query reaches
Colossians 3:23 ('whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and
not for men') with a curated, attributed reason. requiredReasonFamily
is concept_anchor on purpose: neither query shares a token with the
verse's own words, so nothing lexical can drift into a false pass.
The bare query 'work' is deliberately NOT asserted and deliberately NOT
added to the lexicon: it normalises to a single generic token, and the
pack's own fixture already documents (NEEDS-JESSE §1.6d) how a
single-token lexicon entry anchors its verse into EVERY query carrying
that token. 'promotion' queries are covered separately by the
humble-exaltation pack; 'work as for the Lord' phrasings are already
covered by the pack's existing lexicon.
